document.title: Online fraud
document.question:
Online fraud, such as fake shops and messages asking for bank details, is becoming more common in many countries. Some people blame the growing skill of criminals, while others believe the public does not know enough to protect itself.

What are the causes of this problem, and what measures could be taken to tackle it?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
